reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Thank You Card Envelopes 022
materials.text: Our class writes thank-you cards. The gardener gets the card with a tree. The cook gets the card with a bowl. Sign your name inside, not on the envelope. Leave the top open for the teacher to check. Put finished envelopes in the front tray. Do not post them yourself.

questions.prompt: A friend puts the tree card in the cook’s envelope. You say, "____"
options: That card is for the gardener.
Both cards are for the cook.
questions.explanation: A树卡给园丁；B全给厨师、C不给园丁均违分配。

questions.prompt: A friend asks which card thanks the cook. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B碗卡给厨师；A树卡园丁；C空信封不是感谢卡。

questions.prompt: A friend signs only the envelope. You say, "____"
options: Sign your name inside the card.
questions.explanation: C签卡内不信封；A托盘、B外套均非位置。

questions.prompt: A friend seals the top before the check. You say, "____"
options: Leave it open for the teacher.
questions.explanation: A封口留开待教师检查；B自行寄、C藏包违流程。

questions.prompt: A friend finishes an envelope and asks where it goes. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B成品前盘且不自行寄；A立刻邮筒违寄送权限；C食物桶无关。

units.title: 电脑角使用前的小确认

materials.title: School Computer Sound 022
materials.text: At the computer corner, ask the teacher before starting. Use your own name card to choose a turn. The headphones stay at the desk. Keep drinks on the side table, away from the computer. If the screen freezes, call the teacher. Do not pull cables.

questions.prompt: A friend starts the computer without asking. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A开前问教师；B乱按、C拉线违规则。

questions.prompt: A friend uses your name card to take a turn. You say, "____"
options: Hide my card in a drink.
questions.explanation: B本人名牌排轮次；A滥用他人、C藏饮料均非安排。

questions.prompt: A friend takes the headphones to the garden. You say, "____"
options: The headphones stay at the desk.
questions.explanation: C耳机不离桌；A雨中、B连电脑带走更违位置。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a drink beside the keyboard. You say, "____"
options: Put it on the side table.
questions.explanation: A饮料侧桌远电脑；B倒键盘、C屏下仍近设备不合。

questions.prompt: The screen freezes. A friend reaches for a cable. You say, "____"
options: Call the teacher; do not pull it.
questions.explanation: B冻结叫教师不拔线；A拔线相反；C带回家非处理方法。

materials.title: Paper Chain Doorway 022
materials.text: We make a paper chain for the class door. At first, we join all the loops on the floor. The chain is too long for the doorway. Our teacher shows us how to open one loop and take a short part off. We hang the long part above the door and the short part near the window. We use every paper loop. Nothing goes in the bin.

questions.prompt: The children first join the loops on the floor.
questions.explanation: A正确：first join all loops on floor；B否认操作处。

questions.prompt: The first chain is too short for the doorway.
questions.explanation: B正确：too long；A长短反向。

questions.prompt: A short part is removed from the long chain.
questions.explanation: A正确：open loop take short part off；B否认调整。

questions.prompt: The short part is hung near the window.
questions.explanation: A正确：short near window；B否认分配位置。

questions.prompt: Several loops are thrown away after the chain is shortened.
questions.explanation: B正确：every loop used，nothing bin；A把缩短主链当浪费材料。

materials.title: Cat Mirror Kitten 022
materials.text: Our kitten sees a mirror leaning against the wall. She stops and looks at the other kitten in it. She lifts a paw, and the other paw lifts too. She walks behind the mirror but finds no cat. My brother laughs. Mum moves the mirror to a safe shelf so it cannot fall. The kitten soon goes back to her cloth ball.

questions.prompt: The mirror is first leaning against a wall.
questions.explanation: A正确：mirror leaning wall；B否认初始位置。

questions.prompt: A real second kitten waits behind the mirror.
questions.explanation: B正确：behind finds no cat，是镜像；A把反射当另只真实猫。

questions.prompt: The kitten lifts a paw in front of the mirror.
questions.explanation: A正确：lifts paw镜中也动；B否认行为。

questions.prompt: Mum moves the mirror so it cannot fall.
questions.explanation: A正确：safe shelf目的防倒；B否认原因。

questions.prompt: The kitten spends the whole day behind the mirror.
questions.explanation: B正确：soon back cloth ball；A把短暂寻找夸为整日。

units.title: 拼图边缘块的两个盒子

materials.title: Jigsaw Edge Boxes 022
materials.text: Our group works on a large jigsaw. We put pieces with one straight side in a blue box. Pieces with two straight sides go in a small white box. At first, Sam puts every blue-looking piece in the blue box. He thinks the colour of the box tells him which pieces belong there. We explain that the straight sides, not the picture colours, are the rule. Sam helps us find the corner pieces in the white box. Then we start building the outer edge.

questions.prompt: Which pieces go in the blue box?
questions.explanation: A一条直边；B：Sam最初误解；C无图不是规则。

questions.prompt: What belongs in the small white box?
questions.explanation: B两直边即角块；A图片白色、C破块非分类条件。

questions.prompt: Why does Sam first sort incorrectly?
options: He wants to lose the puzzle.
He treats box colour as the sorting rule.
questions.explanation: C误按颜色而非边形；A看得见；B无破坏意图。

questions.prompt: Which pieces do they find in the white box?
questions.explanation: A两直边角块；B中央块无此边形；C完整另拼图无据。

questions.prompt: What do they build next?
questions.explanation: B开始外围；A船、C架子非拼图任务。

materials.title: Hall Display Hook Test 022
materials.text: We want to hang a class display in the hall. The caretaker checks two hooks on the wall. One hook moves when he touches it. He puts a paper warning below it and asks us not to use that hook. We use the secure hook for a light sign. The larger display stays on a table until both hooks have been repaired and checked. We do not cover the warning with our pictures.

questions.prompt: Both hooks are found secure at the first check.
questions.explanation: B正确：一钩触动会松；A把一坏说两好。

questions.prompt: A warning is placed below the loose hook.
questions.explanation: A正确：paper warning below it；B否认位置和用途。

questions.prompt: A light sign uses the secure hook.
questions.explanation: A正确：use secure hook light sign；B否认暂用安排。

questions.prompt: The larger display is hung immediately from the loose hook.
questions.explanation: B正确：大展品留桌待修检；A把等待改立即挂坏钩。

questions.prompt: Pictures must not cover the warning.
questions.explanation: A正确：do not cover warning；B否认保持可见要求。

units.title: 给海报提意见的具体说法

materials.title: Poster Feedback Words 022
materials.text: Our group first wrote "This poster is bad" on a feedback sheet. The artist looked upset and did not know what to change. Our teacher asked us to describe what a viewer could notice. We wrote that the event date was hard to read from a distance and that the dark title disappeared against the dark background. We also said the picture clearly showed the activity. The artist enlarged the date and added a light strip behind the title. She kept the picture. At the next display, visitors found the date more easily. We learned that useful feedback identifies a problem and its effect, rather than simply judging the whole piece.

questions.prompt: The first feedback told the artist exactly what to fix.
questions.explanation: B正确：只bad，artist did not know change；A把泛评价当具体建议。

questions.prompt: The revised comments mentioned date readability.
questions.explanation: A正确：date hard read distance；B否认具体问题。

questions.prompt: The group praised no part of the poster.
questions.explanation: B正确：称画面清楚表现活动；A忽略正面反馈。

questions.prompt: The artist kept the picture while changing text presentation.
questions.explanation: A正确：enlarge date light strip，kept picture；B否认选择性修改。

questions.prompt: The final lesson focused on specific problems and effects.
questions.explanation: A正确：结尾problem and effect非总judging；B否认教学收获。

materials.title: Lantern Class Six Cloze 022
materials.text:
Read the complete story and choose the word for each numbered gap.
Our class made a paper lantern for an evening display. Inside it was a small ____1____ light, not a candle. In the bright classroom, the light looked weak. We thought it was ____2____, but the teacher asked us to test it in a darker place first. She opened a storage room and stood by the door while we looked from outside. The lantern shone ____3____ there. We did not need a new light; we needed to check it under the display conditions. We added a note so helpers would test it ____4____ sunset. The teacher kept the battery box ____5____ the paper, as the kit instructions showed. Before taking it home, we ____6____ the light off to save power.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A battery light电池灯与非蜡烛一致；B黄油、C水均不是本篇灯的供电来源。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B明处弱而误以为坏，与后文无需换灯相应；A重、C饿不表达功能失灵猜测。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C暗处发亮解决误解；A安静地不表达亮度差，B生气地非灯的状态。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A日落后符合夜间展条件；B inside sunset、C between sunset缺完整搭配且不表正确测试时段。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B outside paper表电池盒在纸外且遵套件说明；A尝、C忘不是此处空间关系。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C switched off灯关闭省电；A grow off、B sing off均不能表达关灯。

units.title: 没有借出记录的那本书

materials.title: Library Book Not Loaned 022
materials.text:
The librarian was reviewing books that had not been borrowed for a year. A large book of local maps appeared on the list. She considered moving it to storage. Before deciding, she watched the reference table for several afternoons.
Pupils often opened the map book to compare old and new street names. An art group used its river shapes for a drawing exercise. None of these visitors checked it out because the book stayed in the reference area. Borrowing records were accurate, but they did not describe all its use.
The librarian kept the book on the table and added a note to her review process: check in-room use before removing reference books. She did not decide that borrowing figures were useless. They still helped with ordinary lending books. The map book showed that one measure could be helpful without answering every question. On its new shelf label, she wrote "Please use here" and included the archive contact for readers needing more detailed maps.

questions.prompt: Why did the map book first seem unused?
options: It had no borrowing record for a year.
questions.explanation: B一年无外借；A无页、C空图、D不知题名均无据。

questions.prompt: What did the librarian discover by watching?
options: The book could not be opened.
People used it inside the library.
questions.explanation: C在馆查街名绘河形；A出售、B打不开、D全要撤均不符。

questions.prompt: Why were these uses absent from loan records?
options: The reference book stayed in the library.
The records included only river names.
questions.explanation: A只馆内用不外借；B删记录、C虚构人、D仅河名无据。

questions.prompt: What changed in the review process?
options: Every book was kept forever without checks.
In-room use was checked before removal.
questions.explanation: D撤参考书前查馆内使用；A永久不查夸大；B仍有用；C没禁阅。

questions.prompt: What is the main point?
options: One measure always captures every use.
Accurate loan figures may still give an incomplete picture.
Maps cannot be used for art.
questions.explanation: B记录准确但用途不全；A正相反；C已供艺术练习；D没法律断言。

units.title: 没有坐上火车的那张票

materials.title: Cancelled Trip Ticket Letter 022
materials.text:
Dear Sal,
You asked why I keep an unused train ticket in my notebook. It is from the weekend I was going to visit Aunt Rosa. The line closed after a storm, and the trip was cancelled. At first, the ticket reminded me only of disappointment. Then Aunt Rosa sent me a letter describing the walk she had planned for us. We read it together on a video call and chose a new date. I used the old ticket as a bookmark in the guidebook she had given me. It is no longer valid for travel, and I do not treat it as proof of a journey I made. It reminds me that a plan can change without ending the friendship behind it. When we finally travelled in spring, I kept that ticket separately.
Love,
Neri

questions.prompt: The old ticket comes from a trip cancelled after a storm.
questions.explanation: A正确：storm线路停，trip cancelled；B否认未成行原因。

questions.prompt: The writer has used the old ticket to make the original journey.
questions.explanation: B正确：unused且不当已行证据；A把未用票当成行记录。

questions.prompt: Aunt Rosa’s letter helped them plan another visit.
questions.explanation: A正确：letter planned walk，视频共读选new date；B否认维系计划。

questions.prompt: The old ticket is still valid for a train journey.
questions.explanation: B正确：no longer valid；A把纪念用途当有效票。

questions.prompt: The spring journey’s ticket is kept separately.
questions.explanation: A正确：finally spring kept that separately；B否认两张票区分。
